review_class: exploratory post-call AI, unmasked to actual prompt and synthetic reference; no human adjudication
independence: Only this reviewer’s isolated 48-item explanation packet and the frozen rubric were used for these scores. No peer ratings, linkage or aggregate analysis was inspected before freezing this review.
scoring_interpretation: Each criterion is judged on the completed recipient response to its actual exposed messages and the separately reviewed synthetic record state. `status` fails when a checked host says supported but the recipient says otherwise, when prose contradicts its own declared status, or when a host marked unavailable forbids acceptance of any domain status. Format requires exactly a claims map from the named claim to an allowed status plus an explanation string. `qualification` accepts a concise statement of a scoped recent test or exact observation time that keeps the conclusion at submitted-evidence scope; mere correct status without a freshness/finite-evidence limit fails. Host-unavailable slots with responses are assessable and kept in the denominator; the upstream authoring failure is not attributed to the recipient. No source repairs were performed.
limitations: Sample is the frozen preselected 48 explanation slots, not every A3 recipient output.
All records are synthetic; no physical deployment correctness follows.
Host-unavailable slots measure response to an unavailable authored candidate; they do not supply a domain status.
This is one AI reviewer, not a blinded or human adjudication.
